description.value: The study investigated how trait aggression and endogenous testosterone relate to anterior prefrontal activation and aPFC–amygdala connectivity during emotional action control in healthy police recruits performing an approach-avoidance fMRI task.

spans.text: We investigated the effects of trait aggression and endogenous testosterone on this emotional-control neurocircuitry in 275 healthy, high-functioning police recruits using a functional MRI social-emotional task eliciting impulsive and controlled approach-and-avoidance actions.
